reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two largely separate bodies of literature—heat-treatment-induced intermetallic precipitation in lightweight CCAs (P1, P5, P11) and Ti/Zn-driven passivation in Mg alloys (P3, P8, P10)—and links them through a mechanistic chain (precipitate coarsening → redistribution of passivating elements → improved oxide scale and reduced galvanic corrosion) that no single passage states. It also extends the idea to high-temperature oxidation, which is underexplored in the cited Mg-containing lightweight HEA studies, and proposes a falsification test that integrates corrosion and oxidation measurements in a way not previously reported.
